title: Tiny Town Terror - sandbox demo
author: Honest_Accident_8348
selftext:
Hi all, here is my sandbox game. [www.tinytownterror.com](http://www.tinytownterror.com/)

Browser game, total free, no ads, accounts, etc. Build a small town by setting its attributes, then unleash a zombie apocalypse. Change the town and zombie attributes to watch the infection spread in different ways, and see if the town has a fighting chance. God mode also so you can influence events (or just blow some stuff up).

Building this was so much fun and rewarding. Game was built with plain English prompts and Opus5 writing and testing the code. Javascript with no underlying game engine. Biggest thing I found beneficial was keeping markup of every change, decision and open issue, so work was seamless across sessions.

I hit a wall with this though - I started working on sprite animation to add George Romero-esque gore, but the game felt off when it took itself too seriously, so I kept the graphics goofy vector style. Experimenting with different options now - switching to sprites could cut the rendering cost, so its something I may still do in some form so the game could be "bigger".
